\begin{chapstatus}{Learning status of this chapter}
\masterychip{now}{UNDERSTAND NOW}\enspace two's complement; base conversions; naturals and overflow; shifts as multiplications; sign and magnitude; signed or unsigned instructions; sign extension.\par\smallskip
\masterychip{use}{USE NOW}\enspace the PRG32 runtime calls, the complete program, the PRG32 tools (used, not studied, in this course).\par\smallskip

\begin{chapstatus}{Roadmap of this chapter}
By the end of the chapter you can:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item convert between bases and read an n-bit pattern as unsigned and as two's complement
\item recognise overflow in unsigned and in signed addition
\item choose between signed and unsigned instructions, including lb and lbu
\end{enumerate}
It builds on: only the setup of Chapter~\ref{ch:setup}. Next: Chapter~\ref{ch:reals}.
\end{chapstatus}
